eps.d: Contestant Mark (to get his key) had to get it from a hive of bees. The Interceptor chased contestant Candy (who was travelling in a Rolls Royce) on horseback. Towards the end of the episode, the Interceptor successfully sneaked up on an oblivious Mark and zapped his backpack at point-blank range. After doing so, he screamed into his ear.

While contestant Roger tried to get his key in the middle of a maze in a stately home, the Interceptor planned an ambush. However, Roger got away before the Interceptor could zap him. Contestant Claire went on a pleasure cruise to get near her key on a river as Roger approached.

Contestant Mark enlisted the help of the army to find his key while at the end of the episode, the Interceptor screeched over a bridge in his Maserati. Although the two contestants met up with 1 minute remaining, the Interceptor had zapped their backpacks.

Contestant Max made his way on the Ravenglass and Eskdale Railway to his key challenge and the Interceptor climbed along the train in pursuit of Max. Contestant Suzanne got soaked in Wast Water while trying to get her key. At the end of the episode, the Interceptor blocked the entrance to the Eskdale Outward Bound Centre where contestant Suzanne was coming but her partner Max grabbed her just in…

Contestant Martin had a brief chase with The Interceptor but got away in the nick of time. Contestant Hillary was unaware that she was taken on a ride in a tractor by the Interceptor. The farmers at the farm where she got the tractor even go as far as helping him, all because of a money bribe of ten pounds, and a further ten pounds if his ambush was a success.

The Interceptor wouldn't leave contestant Mike alone as he got his key from the top of a factory, but while attempting an ambush, he was spotted by Mike and gave up. Contestant Sarah cycled down from her starting position to get to her key challenge on a river, only to see the Interceptor nearby in a dinghy.

Contestant Marcel had to escape the chasing Interceptor by quadbike. Contestant Nikki was taken to her key at the top of a burning building and when he started chasing her on foot she finds a way to escape quicker and the Interceptor lost her and at the end of the episode, Marcel was getting his key on a chariot race and the Interceptor was ready to zap him but he was too late and the contestants…

Contestant Clive was successfully ambushed by the Interceptor but had a plan to save his partner Sarah from the Interceptor on a lifeboat. Contestant Sarah had a mini hovercraft ride before coming with the Interceptor but was protected by locals.
